findings.documented: append your API key as ?api_key=... query parameter on every request
findings.actual: rejected with 401; key must go in an X-API-Key request header
findings.how_found: read the 401 error body instead of discarding it
findings.impact: every request built per the docs fails auth

findings.documented: response has a `token` field; tokens last 24h; there is no refresh flow
findings.actual: response has `access_token` and `refresh_token` fields; `expires_in` is 900 (15 min); `/auth/refresh` exists and works
findings.how_found: printed the raw login response body
findings.impact: a frontend built to the docs would silently break 15 minutes in, failing the 'still working 30 minutes after login' requirement

findings.documented: paginate with page & limit (max 200); response is {total, page, page_size, results}
findings.actual: pagination is offset-based; response is {limit, offset, count, total, has_more, results}; page is silently ignored; effective limit is 50
findings.how_found: compared page=1 and page=2 responses and tested a requested limit of 200
findings.impact: a client built to the documented contract repeats the first batch and cannot traverse the collection

findings.documented: the collection response reports the exact total number of matching records
findings.actual: total=4422, but offset pagination returns 4700 unique listings before has_more becomes false
findings.how_found: paged with offset to the final response and compared total with the retrieved unique IDs
findings.impact: clients trusting total stop early and miss 278 listings

findings.documented: a single listing is available at /v1/listing/{listing_id}
findings.how_found: requested both literal paths for MAG-1002627
findings.impact: detail-page clients built to the documented path cannot load listings

findings.documented: returns up to ten comparable listings
findings.impact: the documented comparable-listings feature cannot be implemented against this route

findings.documented: logged-in users can list and save favourites
findings.actual: GET, POST, and DELETE favourites requests return 404; tested spelling and trailing-slash variants also return 404
findings.how_found: called the documented operations with valid authentication
findings.impact: the documented saved-listings workflow cannot use this API

findings.how_found: called it with a valid API key and bearer token
findings.impact: a dashboard built from the documented analytics endpoint has no response to display

findings.documented: returns active sale listings; inactive listings are excluded server side
findings.actual: the collection includes records with is_live=false
findings.how_found: inspected is_live across the corrected full listing pull
findings.impact: clients must filter inactive records themselves

findings.documented: sort_by and order sort the collection
findings.actual: order=desc and omitted order returned the same first five carpet_area records
findings.how_found: compared live responses for sort_by=carpet_area with and without order
findings.impact: users cannot rely on the documented sort direction

findings.documented: money is an integer amount in Indian rupees
findings.actual: some listing price values are negative
findings.how_found: checked price values across the corrected full listing pull
findings.impact: negative prices are impossible as sale prices and break totals, sorting, and display

findings.documented: price_min and price_max are integer rupee amounts
findings.actual: project prices are decimal crore-scale values; P10068 price_max=99.8 means 998000000 INR
findings.how_found: inspected project records and compared their scale with the documented rupee unit
findings.impact: displaying these values as rupees produces prices off by orders of magnitude
